neighbours.label: re-doing something anew: ' re' of rethink and re-edit, ' new' and German ' neu' as 'anew'
fire: The crisis demands a complete rethinking of the plan.
The director asked for the film to be re-edited.
Her book offers a whole new view of Rome.
Das Konzept muss neu gedacht werden.
We need a serious rethinking of our budget.
The chapter had to be re-written twice.
This gives a whole new meaning to the word.
Die Regeln müssen neu geschrieben werden.
quiet: The crisis demands a complete review of the plan.
The director asked for the film to be shortened.
Her book offers a brief tour of Rome.
Das Konzept muss schnell gemacht werden.
We need a serious discussion of our budget.
The chapter had to be read twice.
This gives a clear meaning to the word.
Die Regeln müssen klar geschrieben werden.

notes: ' new' here is only the 'whole new' sense; plain ' new' was not probed.
